title: Pin Envoy Gateway chart version and CPU Torch version for reproducible builds
description:
Two unpinned versions in the deployment path make builds non-reproducible between local POC runs and any future shared environment:

1. docker/scripts/setup_envoy_gateway_poc.sh installs `oci://docker.io/envoyproxy/gateway-helm` with no `--version`; an upstream release can change behavior between runs. Pin the chart version.

2. docker/Dockerfile preinstalls unpinned `torch` from the CPU wheel index. Torch is only a transitive dependency (via transformers / sentence-transformers), so the resolved version floats per build, and a future resolver conflict could reintroduce CUDA wheels. Pin the CPU Torch version next to the index URL.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Progress: pinned reproducibility-sensitive versions. setup_envoy_gateway_poc.sh now installs Envoy Gateway chart version 1.8.1 by default via ENVOY_GATEWAY_CHART_VERSION, and docker/Dockerfile now pins CPU Torch to 2.12.0 via TORCH_VERSION while preserving override args. Added README guidance for intentionally overriding the Envoy chart version. Validation passed: bash -n for the setup script, helm lint/template for the stack, git diff --check, and rg confirmation of the pinned values.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Verified and closed. Envoy Gateway chart pinned to 1.8.1 by default via ENVOY_GATEWAY_CHART_VERSION (overridable), and Dockerfile pins CPU Torch via TORCH_VERSION=2.12.0 alongside the CPU index URL, both confirmed in the working tree. bash -n and helm lint pass.
